It is a bit dimmer than most proper light sources, but can provide some light in the dark. ** The glow effect also makes players slightly easier to detect while [[Sneak_(Skill)|sneaking]], increasing the visibility of its holder by approximately 20%. * Before [[1.0]], the Mistwalker was the only weapon to have mist repulsion at a 5 meter range. Other recipes have not been updated and Mistwalker remains the only weapon which requires Wisp to be crafted. {{Weapons}} [[cs:Mlhošlap]] [[ru:Странник туманов]] [[de:Nebelbrecher]] [[fr:Marchebrume]]
